title: PSTN connectivity models
observation: The documentation distinguishes vendor-managed plans, integrated fixed-line operators, integrated mobile operators and customer/integrator-managed SBC connectivity. Models may coexist within a tenant. Mobile integration supports user numbers, with different support for service numbers.
applicableVersionOrJurisdiction: Current retrieved documentation; availability varies by market and operator.
historicalEvidence: Preserved source document dated 2026-10-29; current retrieval is an observation, not an archived full page.
implementationGap: The foundation exposes only three carrier labels and does not yet model separate onboarding, mobile number restrictions or mixed-carrier ownership.

title: Contact-centre integration boundaries
observation: Connect uses SBC/direct-routing integration; Extend uses Teams client and communications APIs; Unify embeds calling experiences through ACS-based applications. These models differ in control and agent experience.
applicableVersionOrJurisdiction: Current integration overview; certification is solution/version-specific.
historicalEvidence: Preserved source document dated 2026-10-29; current retrieval is an observation, not an archived full page.
implementationGap: The foundation has generic queue handoff only. Distinct integration model state machines and compatibility capabilities remain required.

title: Dedicated calling and coexistence
observation: Dedicated Instance is based on Unified Communications Manager architecture and can coexist with multitenant calling. Calling features are not universally shared across the boundary; the document gives hunt-group participation as a limitation.
applicableVersionOrJurisdiction: Webex document dated 2026-10-16; release-specific endpoints and integrations need their own compatibility checks.
historicalEvidence: Preserved source document dated 2026-10-29; current retrieval is an observation, not an archived full page.
implementationGap: A dedicated label and local flag do not establish isolated cloud hosting or feature-preserving coexistence. Full cluster and interworking contracts remain pending.

title: Local transcription and licensing exception
observation: The appliance data sheet describes local transcription processing and ephemeral captions, but qualifies isolated operation with a licensing exception. It specifies direct-mode Smart Licensing and concurrent-session licensing, distinct from consumption metering.
applicableVersionOrJurisdiction: Cisco data sheet updated 2026-06-16; its licensing exception must remain explicit.
historicalEvidence: Preserved source document dated 2026-10-29; current retrieval is an observation, not an archived full page.
implementationGap: The generic processor-minute archetype must not stand in for this product. A separate concurrent-session, ephemeral-caption appliance with explicit licence connectivity is required.
